facts.text: I need help rewriting some content for our website.
The content is primarily investor focused but should be understandable to anyone.
I want the tone to be serious, formal, respectful, and matter of fact.
Canurta is a preclinical biotechnology company developing botanical solutions for complex, chronic diseases.
Canurta envisions a world where the healing power of nature reverses the tide of chronic illnesses.
Canurta is developing EkaPolyPhaia™, a platform with over 17 global patents across three production processes and a unique AI algorithm.
Canurta’s EkaPolyPhaia™ platform focuses on creating new polyphenols and screening them for activity.
Canurta is building a state-of-the-art facility for research, processing, and production needs.
I want the content shortened into one or two lines.
I want the rewrite to highlight Canurta’s patents.
Canurta’s target audience is investors.
Canurta aims to be science-forward.
I asked whether there should be any change in opinion about the content.
I asked for some cons to using the name Canurta.
Canurta designs natural solutions powered by hemp-derived polyphenols that support prevention and recovery from inflammation.
Canurta claims that its patent-pending extract can be up to 30 times stronger than the leading NSAID.
Canurta claims it is the most potent and natural anti-inflammatory on the market to date.
Canurta claims it is the first and only hemp company that provides dual inhibition of proinflammatory molecules.
Canurta claims it can be trusted as a first-line therapy to prevent and calm strains, stresses, and discomfort caused by inflammatory responses.
I asked what tone the text reads as.
Canurta aims to counteract the global increase in chronic diseases using natural solutions.
Canurta harnesses anti-inflammatory, anti-viral, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective properties of plant polyphenols.
Canurta’s goal is to enhance health outcomes, foster longevity, and break the cycle of chronic disease for both humans and animals.

keyphrases: up to 30 times stronger than leading NSAID
cons of using the name Canurta
